subject: Re: Kickoff: Model Swarms — staffing + the migration date
body:
Hi Anders,

Staffing: Fumiko Rossi 50% leads the method work and owns the utility functions; Freya Ruiz 30% on the two internal retrieval tasks; Leilani Nakamura 40% on the search infrastructure (the released scripts assume a fixed 5-GPU layout via the -g flag — she's generalizing that to our scheduler); Oyin Iversen 30% on expert-pool management and checkpoint hygiene.

Compute: each search run holds 8 experts resident, so we need 40 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort through May, then a burst for the final sweep in June.

Heads-up on the hard date: the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-06-26, the same week Q3 OKRs lock, so the swarm-search validation corpora have to be fully migrated onto v2 before our final sweep or we lose data access mid-run. Leilani has migration tasks in her plan for late May, which is tight but doable.

Bao
